note: The static and semi-static context of the city: what the mind may know about the SHAPE of Belgrade while it thinks about what the instruments say. One layer per question the mind will actually ask; not everything that exists. Every layer is a registered source (SOURCE_REGISTRY.json) with a permission capture, taken once with its hash by tools/fetch_static.py, reduced to a small public context file, and shown as a quiet layer on the map. Values keep their licence; the attribution the licence asks for travels in the derived file.
rule: A context layer is never a measurement. It answers 'what is here' (people, built-up, roads, hazard, decisions), not 'what is happening'. The digest quotes it with its source and its nature (modelled estimate, survey, register) and the interface draws it in structure colour only.

layers.question: How many people live around this instrument / in this zone?
layers.name: Kontur Population Dataset - Serbia (H3 resolution 8)
layers.cadence: yearly release; re-fetched only when the publisher publishes a new file
layers.resolution: H3 res 8, hexagon about 0.74 km2 (~460 m across)
layers.attribution: Kontur Population: Global Population Density for 400m H3 Hexagons (Kontur, 2023), CC BY 4.0
layers.nature: modelled estimate (built-up area from satellite x census totals), not a count
used_by: organ_mind digest: people within 1 km of the stations named in a SEPA spread; people in the map window

layers.question: Is this instrument on a main road? Where does the city move?
layers.name: Putna infrastruktura Srbije - nodes and edges (GeoJSON) on data.gov.rs
layers.licence: to be captured (data.gov.rs default is the Serbian open data licence; the dataset page must say)
layers.status: found 2026-09-09 by a data.gov.rs API search ('geojson'); needs a registry id and a permission capture before any fetch

layers.question: Which municipalities are scheduled to lose power today?
layers.name: Elektrodistribucija Srbije - planned outages per municipality
layers.licence: utility publication; reuse to be confirmed at capture
layers.nature: schedule (a plan, not an observation) - the digest must say 'planned', never 'without power'
layers.status: registered as S54 probe_ok; collector not built

layers.question: How built-up is this zone, and since when?
layers.name: JRC GHSL built-up surface / population grid
layers.status: registered probe_ok; raster parsing (GeoTIFF) is more than a stdlib evening - deferred; Kontur carries the density question for v1

layers.question: Does this zone flood, and how often?
layers.name: JRC Global River Flood Hazard Maps
layers.nature: modelled hazard raster, six return periods

layers.question: What did the city decide, and when?
layers.name: Sluzbeni list grada Beograda (Official Gazette of the City of Belgrade)
layers.licence: no copyright - Copyright Act Art. 6(2) excludes official materials of public bodies
layers.status: identified in 07-legal as the cleanest unused corpus in the country; needs a registry id, a capture and its own organ (gazette-reader) before it enters a digest
